newsitem.title: FINLAND: U.S. gains seen boosting Helsinki shares.
newsitem.headline: U.S. gains seen boosting Helsinki shares.

text.p: Shares were seen opening higher on Monday after U.S. stocks and bonds rose last Friday and Nokia's New York-traded ADRs ended firmly above the share's Helsinki close, brokers said.
"This should be a very bullish day," one broker said, predicting the HEX index would rise by "at least one percent" for the day.
"We underperformed the U.S. market all last week ... (on) a feeling that the rise might not be durable. But this is on a firm base," the broker said.
But another said: "I don't expect any explosion."
A public holiday in the United Kingdom could dampen trade somewhat, brokers said.

Nokia ended at the equivalent of about 333.20 markka on Wall Street last Friday, almost five markka above its Helsinki close. Nokia was likely to rise to match its New York close and that alone would boost the index, brokers said.

"Finnish investors have been speculating that Nokia would fall from the 330.00 level, but look where it went in the U.S.," one broker said. Another major factor supporting shares was lower interest rates, brokers said.
